original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.

actual_scope: Can the production PR543 R420 mutation harness (research/e8-bit-r420/code/mutants.py, exercised by research/e8-bit-r420/verify.sh step 2 on the pinned bitE8mut-r420 word) adopt the exact geometry reuse from research/r420-geometry-cache/ so the shipped path is faster while every mutation stdout field and JSON control receipt stays identical?
scope_change_reason: Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after profiling showed production mutants.py still rebuilt Word.__init__/labels (dominating Fraction RREF) on every gate-only mutation while the incorporated opt-in adapter research/r420-geometry-cache/ already proved identical-receipt geometry reuse across those calls and left production pairwise. Leave-alone objects (joint frames, shared/mixed-point, ternary, parity-side, DisjointTensor.frame_data, verify_factor, leech_minor, sparse-fusion, joint-dual replay, bit-frame frameopt.close, xcheck.rref/#2263, quadratic-affine) and deferred micro-opts were not reopened.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: the R420 mutation harness is a retained historical interface lemma check. Faster identical geometry reuse does not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance for orientation, overlap search, profiling, production wiring, packaging, benchmarking and writing
evidence: PASS_R420_GEOMETRY_CACHE_PRODUCTION via research/r420-geometry-cache-production/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_IDENTICAL_R420_GEOMETRY_CACHE_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS via benchmark.py; MANIFEST.sha256 binds the production mutants digest; identical mutation stdout digest 8c2738b3258e…

stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving production mutants.py geometry-cache change with frozen baseline, identical mutation receipts, temp-copy corruption rejection, registered replay and a measured before/after median. Do not invent kappa or reopen leave-alone objects.
